prBodyNotes: Stays on the Node 22 LTS line: 22.x is the newest line with an official linux-armv7l build (needed by the armhf snap). Node 24+ dropped 32-bit ARM, so the `allowedVersions: <23` ceiling prevents an armhf-breaking major bump. Revisit at Node 22 EOL (2027-04-30).
This PR updates the version of zwave-js-ui in the snapcraft.yaml file to match the latest GitHub release.

packageRules.description: The pip-compile manager owns the store client lock; pip_requirements' hash refresher (hashin) mangles entries uv spells differently from PyPI (pydantic-core, jaraco-*), #251.
The store client lock is CI-only but runs next to the live store credentials, and uv re-runs the header command for every change.

A craft-store release (the .in pin) is taken once it is 7 days old, the header's --exclude-newer=P7D cutoff. The rule is not on lockFileMaintenance: that update has no release timestamp, so an age rule would leave the weekly refresh pending forever; uv's cutoff ages it instead.

craft-store minor/patch and the weekly lock refresh automerge once the required `test` check passes (--require-hashes install + unit tests). The refresh re-resolves every transitive package, majors included (Joachim, 2026-10-25). craft-store majors stay manual.

duplicity (+ python-gettext) ship in the snap. The build installs them but never runs them, and duplicity's runtime deps come from debs pip does not check, so only patch releases automerge, on a green build, once 7 days old.
gum ships in the snap and is only compiled by the build, never run, so only patch releases automerge, on a green build, once 7 days old.
